purpose: Describe a continuing main activity alongside another pursuit.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
V dictionary / N + の + かたわら
I write novels while also working at a company.
Alongside farming, she researched local history.
He continues translating alongside university teaching.
formation: V dictionary / N + の + かたわら
restrictions: The activities coexist over a period, rather than at one exact instant.
mistake: Do not confuse this with がてら for a convenient outing.
